texts.title: X-Ray — see what a code change may affect
texts.youtubeDescription:
X-Ray — see what a code change may affect (with evidence)

X-Ray is a local-first code intelligence tool for TypeScript, React and Next.js. Point it at a repository, pick a Git diff, and it shows what changed, what may be affected, and what to check — every result with evidence: the exact line, the chain that connects it, and a verified/possible confidence label.

• Runs entirely on your machine — your code is never uploaded and never executed
• Change impact from any Git diff, including Next.js routes affected through layouts and middleware
• Honest by design: skipped and unresolved items are listed openly
• Optional AI, off by default, only with explicit consent
• Measured, not claimed: verified relationships matched an independent oracle (TypeScript find-references) on 7 real projects
